reason: The README describes a web UI enhancement that replaces the default model selector with independently scrollable provider and model panels, cross-provider search, and synchronized model selection.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 会话提供带供应商导航、模型列表和跨供应商搜索的增强型模型选择面板。
summaries.en: Provides an enhanced DSH web model picker with provider navigation, model lists, cross-provider search, and synchronized selection.

capabilities: Replaces the web composer model-selection panel
Provides provider/model navigation and cross-provider search
Synchronizes model selection with the built-in model directory
Supports loading, error, retry, empty, theme, and language states
